svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-launch-price-and-cost-reference; chapter number: 3; title: Monthly Prices and Gateway Cost References; subtitle: Keep customer plan prices separate from infrastructure expense and model-spend crossover estimates.; caption: Mikey No Code demonstrates invoice-converter prices, The Bridge Dev demonstrates a subscription with overages, and Bryan Software presents gateway community math.; assumptions note: All six bars are independent monthly dollar references from Mikey No Code, The Bridge Dev, or Bryan Software. They are standalone totals, not deductions or a reconciled profit bridge.; note: Bryan Software explicitly distinguishes the approximate gateway crossover from an audited figure. Mikey No Code tests checkout, free-limit enforcement, and the paid-plan update after publishing.; chart type: waterfall; bars: label: Bridge subscription base; value: 9; display: $9/month plus metered overages; kind: total; label: Invoice Starter; value: 19; display: $19/month for 50 invoices; kind: total; label: Invoice Pro; value: 49; display: $49/month for 500 invoices; kind: total; label: Invoice Team; value: 99; display: $99/month with unlimited usage and priority support; kind: total; label: Gateway infrastructure estimate; value: 200; display: Roughly $200/month infrastructure; kind: total; label: Gateway model-spend crossover; value: 3600; display: About $3,600/month in model spend; kind: total
